question: Eczema disease is related to which of the following part of the human body?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Skin.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Several different types of skin swelling are referred to as eczema.
 
• Dermatitis is another name for eczema.
 
• It result in dry, itchy skin and rashes on the hands, feet, elbows, and knees as well as on the face.
 
• Scratching the skin can make it redden, swell, and become even more itchy.
 
• It is brought on by a confluence of stress, genetics, environmental stimuli, and immune system activation.
